title.purpose: The Volume Tabs name in the header.

body-strong.purpose: The current tab title and settings option names.

label.purpose: Buttons, presets, sound modes, links, section headings, status text and tab badges.

caption.purpose: Tab hosts in the list, settings hints; the mode chip sets it in 600.

tick.purpose: The 0 to 500 scale under the slider.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: The control card and the transient toast only.

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: The active preset segment inside the segmented track.

shadows.name: knob-lift
shadows.purpose: The white slider thumb in both themes.

shadows.name: switch-knob
shadows.purpose: The white switch knob in both themes.

shadows.name: thumb-focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus ring for the slider thumb.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Background, color and border-color changes on every interactive control.

motion.name: knob-slide
motion.purpose: Switch knob travel (14px) and the slider thumb growing to scale(1.1) while dragged.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Keyboard focus on every control except the slider thumb, which uses thumb-focus.

themes.default: Follows prefers-color-scheme until the user picks one; then :root[data-theme] holds light or dark and :root[data-effective-theme] mirrors the applied theme.
themes.tokenSuffix: -dark tokens are the same CSS custom properties redefined for the dark theme.

components.name: Control Card
components.description: The one lifted surface; holds every control for the current tab.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 300px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e1e4e9); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.05), 0 4px 12px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.06)); color: var(--text, #15181d); font: 13px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-host { color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Header and back actions: 30px transparent square with a muted line icon.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5d6573); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); color: var(--text, #15181d); } .ds-icon-btn:active { background: var(--surface-3, #e3e6eb); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Reset and settings commands: card fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-ghost-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e1e4e9); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #15181d); font: 600 12px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-ghost-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); } .ds-ghost-btn:active { background: var(--surface-3, #e3e6eb); } .ds-ghost-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Level Readout
components.description: Round mute button beside the editable display numeral and muted percent sign.
components.html: 250%
components.css: .ds-readout { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #15181d); } .ds-mute-btn { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); color: var(--text, #15181d); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-mute-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #e3e6eb); } .ds-mute-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-level { font: 650 36px/1.1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-unit { margin-left: -7px; align-self: flex-end; padding-bottom: 6px; color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Volume Slider
components.description: 6px round track, accent fill to the current level, 18px white thumb, tick scale below.
components.html: 0100200300400500
components.css: .ds-slider-wrap { width: 280px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; } .ds-slider { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; display: block; width: 100%; height: 24px; margin: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent, #2563eb) var(--pos), var(--control-off, #8e95a0) var(--pos)); } .ds-slider::-moz-range-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--control-off, #8e95a0); } .ds-slider::-moz-range-progress { height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: -6px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.12), 0 1px 3px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.3); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-thumb { box-sizing: border-box; width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.12), 0 1px 3px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.3); } .ds-slider:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-slider:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-slider:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #e8effd), 0 0 0 5px var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-slider:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #e8effd), 0 0 0 5px var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-ticks { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 2px 9px 0; color: var(--faint, #626975); font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ticks span { display: flex; justify-content: center; width: 0; }

components.name: Preset Segmented Control
components.description: Six equal presets in a soft-fill track; the current level lifts to the card surface.
components.css: .ds-presets { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 2px; width: 280px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); } .ds-presets button { height: 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font: 600 12px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-presets button:hover { color: var(--text, #15181d); } .ds-presets button.active { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #15181d); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(21, 24, 29, 0.06)); } .ds-presets button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sound Mode Selector
components.description: One of three sound modes (Default, Voice, Bass) as a radio group; the selected mode is a pale blue wash.
components.css: .ds-modes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 100px); gap: 6px; } .ds-mode { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; height: 32px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e1e4e9); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font: 600 12px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); color: var(--text, #15181d); } .ds-mode[aria-checked="true"] { border-color: transparent; background: var(--accent-soft, #e8effd); color: var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); } .ds-mode span { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: iOS-style 34 by 20px switch: grey when off, accent when on, white sliding knob.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 280px; padding: 6px 0; color: var(--text, #15181d); font: 13px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; position: relative; flex: none; width: 34px; height: 20px; margin: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--control-off, #8e95a0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-switch:checked { background: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-switch:checked::after { transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mode Chip
components.description: Non-interactive pill naming the active audio engine.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font: 600 11px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; }

components.name: Playing Tab Row
components.description: Flat row on the grey ground that lifts to the card surface on hover; badge turns orange above 300%.
components.css: .ds-tabs { width: 300px; padding: 6px; background: var(--bg, #f4f5f7); } .ds-tab-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 7px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #15181d); font: 13px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tab-row:hover { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); } .ds-tab-row:active { background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); } .ds-tab-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-favicon { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-tab-row:hover .ds-favicon { background: var(--surface-2, #eef0f3); } .ds-tab-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-tab-title { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab-host { color: var(--muted, #5d6573); font-size: 11px; } .ds-badge { flex: none; color: var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge.high { color: var(--high, #c2410c); } .ds-flag { display: flex; color: var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); }

narrative.overview:
Volume Tabs looks like the volume popup people already expect from a well-made browser extension, and nothing more. There is no concept, no metaphor and no ornament: a neutral grey ground, one white (light) or near-black (dark) card that holds every control for the current tab, a row list of other playing tabs below it, and a single blue accent that marks what is filled, toggled, focused or clickable. The craft shows in alignment, contrast and state, not in decoration.

The popup is dense and fixed at 340px wide, built for a few seconds of use on a tab that is already playing. The level numeral is the largest thing on screen; every other element is a familiar control (slider, segmented presets, toggle buttons, iOS-style switches, a round mute button) at small product-UI sizes. Exactly two themes exist. The first open follows the operating system, then one header toggle switches and remembers the choice.

The voice is calm. Orange is the only second hue, and it appears only when the level is high enough to risk distortion. Volume Master is the bar for scope and finish, but the system is its own and must not drift into a clone of it.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grey ground, one lifted card, flat rows and settings groups.
One blue accent; orange reserved for levels above 300%.
System sans only, hierarchy by size and weight, tabular numerals everywhere numbers change.
Gently rounded corners (8px to 12px) with concentric nested radii.
Quiet 150ms ease-out state changes, removed under reduced motion.
Two complete themes with mirrored token names.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only accent. It marks filled, on, focused and clickable things; no surface, heading or border is ever blue at rest.

rules.name: The Orange Means Loud Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only when the level is above 300% (slider fill, level numeral, tab badge). It is never decorative and never used below that threshold.

rules.name: The Mirrored Theme Rule
rules.body: Every color has exactly a light and a dark value under the same token name. A new color is not done until both exist and both pass WCAG AA.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or lines up (level numeral, ticks, presets, tab badges) uses tabular figures so values never jitter.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case in `muted` at 12px/600. No uppercase, no letter-spaced labels, no small text above a heading.

rules.name: The One Lifted Card Rule
rules.body: Only the control card (and the toast while it shows) casts a card shadow. Settings groups, rows, buttons and the status line stay flat.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: An element inside a padded rounded container takes the container's radius minus the padding, so curves stay parallel.

dos: **Do** take every color from the token set and supply both the light and the dark value under the same name.
**Do** keep blue (`accent`) for fill, on, focus and link states, and switch the level color to `high` only above 300%.
**Do** use the system sans stack with tabular figures for any number that changes.
**Do** separate elements with tonal fills (`surface-2`, `surface-3`) and 1px hairlines; give the card lift only to the control card and the toast.
**Do** keep corners concentric: 12px containers, 10px rows and tracks, 8px controls, 7px nested items, full round for continuous controls.
**Do** animate only color, background and small transforms at 150ms ease-out, and remove transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** show keyboard focus with the 2px `accent` outline at 2px offset (the slider thumb uses its double ring instead).
donts: **Don't** add a second accent hue, a gradient surface or a tinted background; the ground stays neutral grey.
**Don't** use orange for anything but a level above 300%.
**Don't** load remote fonts, images or icon fonts; icons are inline SVG line icons.
**Don't** add a visual concept, metaphor or illustration; the popup stays plain and familiar.
**Don't** add uppercase labels, letter-spaced labels or small text above headings.
**Don't** put card shadows on settings groups, list rows or buttons.
**Don't** copy Volume Master's layout or styling; match its scope and finish, not its look.
